content.name: Maya Lafleur
content.title: Associate Product Manager
content.summary: Associate product manager at a Calgary payments start-up, two years after finishing a BCom at the Haskayne School of Business. Learned product basics in an eight-month co-op at a rental marketplace and now own invoicing features for 4,000 small businesses. Bilingual in English and French and quick to turn customer calls into clear tickets.

experience.title: Associate Product Manager
bullets: Own the invoicing feature set for about 4,000 small-business customers, working with four developers and a part-time designer.
Shipped recurring invoices after 20 customer calls; paid-plan upgrades among invoicing users rose by 8% in the following quarter.
Wrote acceptance criteria and ran sprint demos, and keep a public changelog in English and French.
Built a Looker dashboard tracking invoice payment times by industry for the sales team.

experience.title: Product Co-op Student
bullets: Synthesized 300 support tickets into a ranked list of renter pain points for the product lead.
Ran usability tests with 12 renters on a new application form, leading to a shorter flow that raised completion by 10%.
Maintained the bug backlog and joined sprint planning twice a month.

education.degree: Bachelor of Commerce (BCom), Business Technology Management
education.school: University of Calgary, Haskayne School of Business

courses.name: Professional Scrum Product Owner I (PSPO I)

achievements.detail: Finalist in a western Canadian business technology case competition (2023).
